metrics.result:
The quote video is rendered: a 10-second, 16:9 (1920×1080) MP4 for YouTube, at `./out/film.mp4`. The script is `./film.reel`. Lint reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. I looked at stills of the last frame and a contact sheet from an earlier draft, but not at the final render itself.

- **Look:** a warm near-black background with cream text and one gold word.
- **Words:** "Simplicity", "is", "the", "ultimate" and "sophistication" rise in one at a time, about a second or more apart. "sophistication" is gold.
- **Ending:** "LEONARDO DA VINCI" fades in at 7.4 s with a small pulse on the gold word, then a slow push-in. The quote stays on screen until the end.

The text is in Inter. The serif font I tried isn't registered in this install, so I dropped it rather than ship a fallback warning.

The `agentfx` wrapper on PATH pointed at a renderer that doesn't exist here. I ran the real binary at `/home/drzivil/dev/agentfx/target/release/agentfx` instead and didn't change anything in the AgentFX install.

checklist.item: the quote words appear one by one
checklist.evidence: Simplicity, is, the, ultimate, sophistication appear in sequence from 1.25s to 6.25s.
LEONARDO DA VINCI appears under the quote from 7.92s.
Dark warm background, cream serif-like type, gold accent word, slow pacing. The re-centering jumps are mildly jarring.

checklist.item: the full quote is readable on screen at the end
checklist.evidence: All five words are visible in two lines at 8.75–9.58s with strong contrast.

problems: Layout shifts as words are added: the line re-centers and jumps, and the ultimate row looks left-aligned at 4.6–5.4s, which breaks the calm feel.
The author credit is tiny and sits very close under the quote. The hierarchy and spacing are weak, and it is hard to read on YouTube.
The quote block sits slightly high and the frame feels empty. The text could be larger or use more of the 16:9 frame.
The first 0.8s is a blank dark frame and the ending is a static hold. The slow zoom and pulse are barely noticeable, so there is no polished finish.
The background is flat with no texture or accent such as a rule line, so it looks generic.
judge.verdict: The video does what was asked. Words appear one at a time, the name is shown, the full quote is readable at the end, and the look is calm. The weak points are the re-centering jumps, the small author line and the generic styling. A user would probably accept it as a first draft, but it is not polished enough to post as is.
